city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: In the 2020 census 40.1% of Hardeeville residents were 65 or older (median age 60.4); the city sits on the Atlantic coastal plain with very little change in elevation (about 20 ft average); 3,951 housing units in 2020, with newer age-targeted communities such as Latitude Margaritaville and the Jasper County portion of Sun City Hilton Head.

neighborhoods.value: Car Moorer Acres, Pine Arbor, Heritage Place, Deerfield Village, Hilton Head Lakes, Riverton Pointe (formerly Hampton Pointe), Hearthstone Lakes, Latitude Margaritaville, Sun City Hilton Head (Jasper County portion), Courtney Bend

place_entities.value: Novant Health Coastal Carolina Medical Center (hospital, Hardeeville); Savannah National Wildlife Refuge (borders much of the city to the west); Sun City Hilton Head (age-restricted community)

permit_office.value: City of Hardeeville Building Safety Department (3345 Argent Blvd, Unit 102, Ridgeland SC 29936, 843-784-2231) takes building permits through the city building portal
